ordering_scope: Alternating within each three-pair stratum (2:1 first position); exactly balanced across both unit strata, not perfectly balanced within one policy.
input_binding: Both routes verify original snapshot/work binding on every query; the unchanged index also rehashes its own records/settings.
first_query_scope: New strategy object in a warmed process; no claim of cold OS cache or fresh-process startup.
allocation_scope: Separate tracemalloc peak during common reconstruction, route build and one full batch, excluding preloaded original byte strings; native allocations are unobserved.
persisted_index_reason: No persisted index representation exists; do not substitute a debug encoding or Python object size.
resource_policy: Serial one CPU/backend thread with unchanged conservative admission/pressure stops; calibration before paired samples; no148/165retry.
